prompts.narrative.prose.implication.kind.claims_: Actual against expected is the test every reserve assumption has to pass. | The gap between actual and expected claims is what the next valuation has to explain. | Experience set against expectation is where a reserve first shows strain.
How incurred claims develop decides whether the reserve holds. | Incurred claims are what the reserve has to cover as they develop.
Notifications are the leading edge of the claims cost still to come. | Each notification is a cost the reserve has not yet settled. | What is notified now is paid later.
Settlement keeps pace only when settled claims track notifications.
prompts.narrative.prose.implication.kind.portfol: The size of the book sets the scale every claims figure should be read against. | Read against the book, the claims counts are what they should be measured on. | A book this size is the denominator for every claims rate below.
prompts.narrative.prose.implication.kind.reserve: Deterioration is a change in the claims themselves, so it cannot be released away. | Deterioration is cost, not timing, and the reserve has to carry it. | What has deteriorated stays deteriorated; no release undoes it.
A pattern change moves timing more than cost, which is why it is reported apart.
Strengthening is the cost of recognising the deterioration now rather than later.
The booked figure is what the result carries, whatever was recommended.
The central estimate is the actuaries' view; anything booked above it is margin, not expectation. | The central estimate is the reference every release is measured from.
Margin may move only against that recommendation, which is why it is the reference point here. | The recommendation is the committee's sign-off, and the booking has to answer to it.
That gap is the margin still held against adverse development.
Claims incurred but not reported are the part of the reserve no ledger can yet confirm.
Releasing margin improves the quarter and thins the buffer behind it. | A release of margin flatters the result in the quarter it is taken.
The basis is the standard every release has to be measured against.
The policy is the floor the booked margin is judged against.
The ultimate is where each cohort is expected to settle, so a movement here moves the reserve.
